text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I visited the track—
(Beep-beep, beep-beep-beep... Standby)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
SO SICKKK--!!
It's a real robot!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's the remote-controlled pace-maker machine, 'Kakeru-kun.'
I need you to run alongside this.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
I'm just about to help out with Tachyon-senpai's experiment!
As thanks for appearing in my hero show!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon is infamous for her suspicious experiments.
...I should probably keep a close eye on her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Then without further ado, let's race full speed against Kakeru-kun—

text_block_list.name: Kakeru
text_block_list.text: (Bzzzzz... INITIATING STARTUP. ...GO!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa!! What is this robot!?
Wait, don't come this waaay!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! That's true.
Though I haven't even touched the controls yet.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, they're completely out of control!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, leave it to me!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaahhhhhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, gasp*...
I managed to hold it in check somehow...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Biko-kun!
Taking off running out of nowhere... you really are—
choice_data_list: That's right, are you hurt anywhere...?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What a magnificent person you are!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Look at that acceleration to close the gap!
That stretch wasn't in any of our past match race data!
She pushed past her limits!! Meaning—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's the matter?
Why do you have such a dazed look on your face?
choice_data_list: N-No, shouldn't you be worried about your body first...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm, oh, right! If it puts too much strain
on your body, we can't call it a success!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine!
I'm just glad it worked out well!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Splendid...! It was quite unexpected, but all's well that ends well!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, while your body is still all warmed up,
there's something I'd like you to try—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a parade of dangerous research, as expected.
Going along with this any further might be...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're worried about me, aren't you?
Thank you! But... I'm alright!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-senpai has never hurt a friend in her experiments!
Besides—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I know full well! Just how seriously
Tachyon-senpai takes her research.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "I'm pouring so much passion into it that I completely forget to eat or sleep!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So much that you wouldn't even care if people looked at you weirdly!
...Doesn't that mean...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We're the same—always doing special training
so we can become heroes!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: The road to becoming a hero isn't easy. Sometimes, nothing goes right at all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I can't stop moving forward!
Because—”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Because that's what chasing a dream is all about!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-senpai, let's keep going!
I'll take on everything you've got!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph.
It seems I am quite trusted indeed.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I believe in your passion!
choice_data_list: If that's what you want to do... then I'll lend you a hand too!
If that's what you intend to do... then I'll lend you my strength!
...I'll buckle down and reshape my mindset too.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I believe in your passion!
choice_data_list: If that's what you want to do... then I'll lend you a hand too!
If that's what you intend to do... then I'll lend you my strength!
...I'll buckle down and reshape my mindset too.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
!! Thank you!
Having you help out is so reassuring, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
................
—Ah, right, of course.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of testing the specially made water gun as well.
It was conceived as a hint for breaking through the pack, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, depending on how we use it,
it could be useful for hero shows too, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
!! I'm in, I'm in!!
Ehehe, experiments like that are always welcome!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ashamed of doubting my own commitment to chasing the dream,
I pulled myself together with renewed resolve.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm.
You lot are certainly an unusual bunch.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...I, too, am a scientist of sorts.
Next time, I shall ensure it is perfected.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, a rematch with Kakeru-kun it is!
I'll stick with Tachyon-senpai until she's satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Kakeru-kun was repaired.
Biko Pegasus ran alongside it time and again,
breaking past her limits!
